annotations.text:
The body carousel turns through seven hulls and one stop that is not a hull. Spectate has no drawing, so 168 points of glass sit empty over the word.

Four drawings for that hole.

None of the four wears the team color. A hull is drawn in pal.FRIEND because the ship you turn to is the ship you fly; a watcher flies nothing and holds no side, so these are in the instrument gray and only the word stays blue.

Chris: what about the human icon, the ship with feathers?

It is the one mark in the game whose subject is the pilot rather than the ship, and this is the one stop whose subject is the pilot rather than the ship. Both hold still: a badge turning is a decal spinning.

Chris: the feathers need work at this resolution. Parallel, sharp edges, thin at the ship and thicker as they go out.

All three, plus both ends cut on a line. The strip along the bottom is the check that matters: pilot_mark is one function, and the scoreboard draws it at eleven points.
